ON-DEMAND WEBINAR

# Summer 2026 Product Launch.

Accelerate the path from digital signals to intelligent action.

[Watch now](https://www.quantummetric.com/events/2026-summer-product-launch#webinar)

## What's new at Quantum Metric.

In this session, the Quantum Metric team walks through everything new across three areas of the platform.

- **Agentic analytics**— See how Felix Agentic capabilities help teams automate monitoring, investigate KPI changes, and get to answers without manual analysis. This includes how beta customers used these and what they built with them.
- **Expanded digital visibility** — Get a closer look at new features that give your teams better coverage across mobile, AI-driven traffic, and third-party integrations, so you have a more complete view of what your customers are actually doing.
- **Simplified platform experience** — See the workflow improvements designed to reduce the overhead of day-to-day platform use, so your team spends less time managing and more time acting.

![Speaker lineup graphic featuring circular headshots and job titles for six presenters, including Lauren Edwardson, Jamie Milstein, Chris Nowack, Brian Pohuski, Dylan Smith, and Nate Wright.](https://www.quantummetric.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fy6rt62dj%2Fproduction%2Ff4990815f35152f1dbe35495fff9f4c865ca681a-1920x1080.jpg%3Fw%3D3840%26fit%3Dmax%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## Have you joined The Quad yet?

The Quad is a community of those passionate about building a customer-centric future.

On The Quad, you can be inspired by other digital leaders, hone your Quantum Metric expertise, share insights, ask tough questions, and express your love for your customers.

[Learn more](https://thequad.quantummetric.com/)
